content: The age of the universe is estimated to be approximately **13.8 billion years**. This value is based on measurements of the cosmic microwave background radiation, the expansion rate of the universe (the Hubble constant), and models of Big Bang cosmology. Observations from missions like the **Planck satellite**, along with other astrophysical studies, have refined this estimate over time.
